:::{#thm-diff-loghaz}
#### Difference of log-hazards vs hazard ratio

If $\diffloghaz(t|\vx : \vxs)$ is the difference in log-hazard
between covariate patterns $\vx$ and $\vxs$ at time $t$,
and $\hr(t| \vx : \vxs)$ is corresponding hazard ratio,
then:

$$\diffloghaz(t|\vx : \vxs)= \logf{\hr(t| \vx : \vxs)}$$
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

::: proof

Using the [hazard ratio definition](intro-to-survival-analysis.qmd#def-hazard-ratio):

$$
\ba
\diffloghaz(t|\vx : \vxs)
&\eqdef \loghaz(t|\vx) - \loghaz(t|\vxs) && \text{(definition of log-hazard difference)}
\\
&= \logf{\haz(t|\vx)} - \logf{\haz(t|\vxs)} && \text{(definition of log-hazard)}
\\
&= \logf{\frac{\haz(t|\vx)}{\haz(t|\vxs)}} && \text{(difference of logarithms rule)}
\\
&= \logf{\hr(t| \vx : \vxs)} && \text{(definition of hazard ratio)}
\ea
$$

:::
